description: Find published templates that parse a site into structured JSON instead of HTML. Pass the url you are about to fetch to see whether one already covers it — do this before writing your own extraction for a well-known site. Also searches by keyword or category. Each result shows the fields it returns and an example call; pass its reference as unblock_fetch's template argument. Free — no credit is charged.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. 'search-results', 'real-estate', 'business-directories'. Omit all filters to see the categories.

page.description: Which page of `limit` results to return, from 1, when more templates match than fit.

search.description: Keyword matched against a template's name, reference, host and description (e.g. 'property', 'company').

url.description: A URL you intend to fetch. Returns the templates built for that site, if any.

name: find_templates
title: Find a structured-data template
